title: Underspecification in Language Modeling Tasks: A Causality-Informed Study of Gendered Pronoun Resolution

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the softmax probabilities of predicted gendered pronouns after injecting time (dates) and location (countries) tokens into gender-neutral text using a custom Masked Gender Challenge (MGC) evaluation set. Additionally evaluates gender vs. occupation spurious correlations using pronoun coreference resolution on the Winogender benchmark.
